baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusive construction joins يزدهم, دعائي, and فرارا: increase, a call that draws near, and flight.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call applies an attracting vector, but the only measured increment runs in the opposite direction. The ayah therefore depicts a causal inversion rather than mere nonresponse.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth supply the measurable gain whose content is restricted to flight.
Calling by speech to draw near supplies the intended inward direction that the result reverses.
Flight and escape supply the sole outward result of the call.

changed_reading.before: Noah's call was followed by greater refusal.
changed_reading.after: The call behaves as an inverse attractor: every attempted drawing-near is converted into added distance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: دعائي and فرارا can carry images of successive collapse and return to the beginning inside the increase construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Each added call initiates another collapse of approach and resets the encounter to its starting distance. Increase counts iterations of a failed loop, not cumulative progress.

activation_trace.role: Increase supplies accumulation across repeated iterations.
Successive falling or collapse supplies the failure that propagates from one call to the next.
Return to the beginning makes each flight a reset of the encounter.

changed_reading.before: Repeated calls simply produced more instances of fleeing.
changed_reading.after: Each call collapses the attempted approach and returns the hearers to their initial distance, so repetition accumulates resets.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of يزد admits the non-dominant provision-for-transition image beside دعائي and فرارا.
baseline_models.mechanism: What should add guidance is received as equipment for departure. The invitation paradoxically becomes material by which the recipients sustain movement away from it.

activation_trace.role: Carrying provision for a journey supplies an exploratory transition-image for the increment.
The invitation supplies what is perversely converted into travel support.
Escape supplies the journey's direction away from the caller.

changed_reading.after: The call is perversely taken up as provision that lets flight continue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening warning is designed to awaken caution before an approaching harm, yet the focus response redirects escape from the warned-of danger toward the warning call itself.

activation_trace.role: The drawing-near call becomes the object from which distance is made.
Flight supplies a cautionary motion aimed at the wrong object.
A warning that frightens and awakens caution supplies the intended defensive response.
Temporal precedence supplies the interval in which warning could redirect conduct.
The coming of adversity supplies the actual danger from which the warning offers escape.

structural_cues: 71:1 places warning before the arrival of painful punishment; 71:6 reports flight from the intervening call.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, a before-interval, and approaching adversity; I infer that the hearers transfer caution from the danger to its messenger; alternatively, 71:1 may provide chronology without specifying such transfer.

changed_reading.before: They flee because they are called.
changed_reading.after: They perform a misdirected precaution, fleeing the warning apparatus instead of the danger it identifies.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night-and-day coverage and the every-time construction turn increase into a ratchet: each renewed encounter adds another unit of flight without allowing reversal.

activation_trace.role: Increase supplies the accumulating count across encounters.
Flight supplies the one-way output added on every cycle.
The repeated call supplies the recurring input to the ratchet.
Night and its darkness supply one half of continuous temporal coverage.
Day opening in light supplies the complementary half of that coverage.
Wholeness and totality make every renewed call part of the same repeated response.

structural_cues: 71:5's night/day pair precedes 71:6, and 71:7 resumes with an every-time clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continuous temporal coverage and an every-time recurrence; I infer a one-way accumulation across attempts; alternatively, the phrases may emphasize prophetic persistence without describing a ratchet in the hearers.

changed_reading.before: The call had the general effect of increasing flight.
changed_reading.after: Each temporally exhaustive renewal clicks the hearers into another increment of flight, making refusal path-dependent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah decomposes flight into a stationary defensive architecture: reject auditory intake, place a cover over the body, bind the refusal, and overpower the encounter.

activation_trace.role: Flight supplies withdrawal, now realized without locomotion.
Listening and accepting what is heard supply the sensory gate that is deliberately blocked.
A covering that rises over and conceals supplies the enclosure's outer layer.
Garment and covering supply the material used to make withdrawal bodily.
Tightening and binding supply the locking action that stabilizes refusal.
Overpowering contest supplies the social posture that turns enclosure into resistance.

structural_cues: The branchless finger image at 71:7 physically plugs the ears before garment-covering, persistence, and intensified arrogance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked ears, covering, persistence, and self-magnification; I infer that these are nested implementations of فرارا; alternatively, they may be consequences listed after a more ordinary notion of flight.

changed_reading.before: Flight means moving away from the caller.
changed_reading.after: Flight is a portable enclosure built in place, closing perception and social receptivity while the body remains present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The call explicitly offers protective covering and connected material abundance. Against that supply sequence, the split provision branch of يزد sharpens the paradox: offered resources are converted into capacity for continued departure.

activation_trace.role: Provision carried through transition supplies the focus model's travel-equipment image.
Escape gives the supplied transition its perverse direction.
Covering sin and protecting its bearer supply non-material shelter within the offer.
Abundant outflow from a source supplies the offer's pouring abundance.
Connected increase that supports another supplies the logic of resourcing.
Accumulated wealth supplies a concrete form of the offered increase.
A river cutting the ground with flowing water supplies durable provision and movement.

structural_cues: 71:10-12 expands the call into forgiveness, rain, wealth, sons, gardens, and rivers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a resource-rich offer and a split focus branch of journey provision; I infer that refusal converts offered supply into endurance for flight; alternatively, the abundance list may only contrast benefit with rejection and need not provision the rejection itself.

changed_reading.before: The call somehow gives rise to more flight.
changed_reading.after: Even the call's shelter and abundance are metabolized as provisions for maintaining distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding creation sequence presents ordered stages, layer after layer, growth, and return. The focus increase runs as their negative counterpart: repeated input yields no maturation but repeated return to the starting refusal.

activation_trace.role: Growth supplies the developmental expectation attached to increase.
Return to the beginning supplies the reset that defeats maturation.
Successive stages supply an ordered model of development.
State after state supplies cumulative transition rather than circular reset.
Human growth and nurture supply the maturation that the focus response refuses.
Return after departure supplies a larger cycle against which the smaller refusal-loop is read.

structural_cues: 71:14-18 moves through stages, layered heavens, human growth from earth, return, and renewed emergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered development and return; I infer that focus flight is counter-development, increasing repetitions while resetting formation; alternatively, the creation sequence may be evidentiary discourse rather than a model for the hearers' response.

changed_reading.after: The hearers undergo counter-development: iterations increase, but each one returns formation to its beginning instead of advancing through stages.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth is spread and made traversable through extended roads and broad passes. This spatial sequence gives flight infrastructure: openness meant to enable passage can be directionally appropriated away from the call.

activation_trace.role: The call supplies the intended destination toward which movement should bend.
Escape supplies movement in the contrary direction.
Spreading and extension supply the open surface on which distance can grow.
Penetrating along a road supplies actual traversal rather than static separation.
An extended road supplies a durable route for the movement.
A broad opening between mountains supplies widened escape capacity.

structural_cues: 71:19-20 joins a spread earth to the purpose clause about traversing its broad ways.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spread terrain and traversable broad routes; I infer that the focus's growing distance can recruit this affordance; alternatively, the roads may invite purposeful travel without any backward link to flight.

changed_reading.before: Flight is an abstract increase in distance.
changed_reading.after: Flight acquires infrastructure, converting created openness and routes into sustained movement away from the call.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later repetitions of the restrictive increase construction turn the focus into the first term of a worsening series. Increase is a neutral amplifier whose outputs progress from flight to loss, error, and destruction.

activation_trace.role: Increase supplies the repeated operator first instantiated in the focus.
Flight supplies the series' first worsening output.
The repeated increase verb supplies the second application of the same operator.
General decrease supplies the paradoxical output of material increase.
A third increase occurrence extends the operator from report into petition.
Deviation from guidance supplies the next and more explicit directional output.
The final increase occurrence closes the repeated grammatical series.
Destruction, nullification, and breaking supply the terminal output of the series.

structural_cues: The focus's لم يزدهم ... إلا is echoed by 71:21's لم يزده ... إلا and by لا تزد ... إلا in 71:24 and 71:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies four restrictive increase formulas and their ordered complements; I infer a single amplifying grammar with escalating outputs; alternatively, each repetition may make a local contrast without constituting a progressive series.

changed_reading.before: 71:6 is an isolated complaint that preaching backfired.
changed_reading.after: 71:6 inaugurates the surah's inverse-gain grammar: inputs amplify an already adverse direction until flight becomes loss, error, and terminal breaking.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following links flight to social succession, while later misguidance and birth language show the pattern reproducing through dependents and offspring. Distance from the call becomes a transmitted relation rather than an isolated reflex.

activation_trace.role: The call attempts to draw a collective toward a different affiliation.
Flight supplies the distance that becomes socially transmissible.
Allegiance and succession supply the social channel through which direction is copied.
Something generated from another supplies reproduction beyond the first hearers.
Deviation from guidance supplies the direction transmitted to others.
Breaching a covering and departing from right supply the inherited rupture.
Veiling truth supplies the durable perceptual condition passed onward.

structural_cues: 71:21 places following before the wealth-and-child loss formula; 71:27 links leaving the group to misleading servants and producing a like successor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, misguiding, and generation; I infer that the focus flight is reproduced through allegiance and succession; alternatively, the later birth statement may classify anticipated offspring without describing transmission of the focus response.

changed_reading.before: Each hearer individually recoils from the call.
changed_reading.after: Flight is a socially copied and generationally renewed distance, maintained by whom people follow and what their order produces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The apparent outward geometry of flight is reversed by engulfment, forced entry, failed finding, and absent help. Movement away from the call does not create an outside; it terminates in comprehensive enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Escape supplies the attempted movement toward an outside.
Comprehensive engulfment removes the open exterior toward which flight aims.
Entry into an interior reverses the focus's outward motion.
Finding or reaching a thing supplies the search that fails after escape.
Aid and making manifest supply the unavailable rescue at the route's end.

structural_cues: 71:25 sequences being drowned, being made to enter fire, and finding no helpers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies engulfment, inward entry, and failed rescue; I infer that these complete the spatial trajectory begun by focus flight; alternatively, 71:25 may state punishment without retrospectively defining the geometry of 71:6.

changed_reading.before: Flight increases separation and offers an apparent exit.
changed_reading.after: Each added flight follows a false exit whose endpoint is engulfment and enforced interiority with no reachable aid.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the probing/showing branch of ف ر ر is distant from ordinary flight, but it remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the later public/secret contrast; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary diagnostic reading, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's فرارا bears a branch of probing and drawing out what is hidden, while دعائي supplies the eliciting address.

activation_trace.role: Riddle-like prompting supplies an address designed to draw out a hidden answer.
Probing, showing, and drawing out the hidden supply a diagnostic sense of the result.
Visible manifestation supplies the overt side of the diagnostic test.
Penetration into hidden matters supplies the covert side of the test.

changed_reading.before: The call causes a preexisting group to flee more.
changed_reading.after: Across overt and covert address, the call probes the group and increases the visibility of a flight-disposition already hidden within it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant د ع ع split mapping's forceful-thrust branch for a د ع و focus occurrence; it remains anchored by the packet's authorized split inventory and the immediate flight result, but should be rendered as the hearers' phenomenological reception of the call, never as the ordinary morphology of دعاء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps focus دعائي to both د ع و and the non-dominant د ع ع inventory, whose forceful driving image can meet فرارا as recoil.

activation_trace.role: Rough thrusting and forceful driving supply an exploratory image of how the recipients register the call.
Flight supplies recoil from the subjectively experienced thrust.

changed_reading.before: A verbal invitation unexpectedly produces escape.
changed_reading.after: From the resistant hearers' perspective, the invitation is experienced as a shove, and their added flight is recoil.

strongest_changes: The immediate context turns flight from locomotion into a repeated, bodily architecture of blocked reception.
The later restrictive increase formulas make 71:6 the first term in an inverse-gain series ending in loss, error, and destruction.
The drowning-entry-no-help sequence reverses escape's geometry: movement toward an outside ends in comprehensive enclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's three roots support unusually concrete directional transformations: a drawing-near call becomes added distance, growth becomes reset or provision for departure, and flight becomes enclosure, social reproduction, diagnostic exposure, and finally a failed exit.
remaining_uncertainties: The provision reading depends on the authorized but non-dominant ز و د mapping and should remain exploratory.
The developmental and route models infer backward links from later creation discourse that may instead function independently as evidence.
The probing and forceful-thrust outliers are branch-distant and must not displace the ordinary flight-and-calling senses.
